name: Ring
overview: The Bible presents rings as significant symbols of authority, covenant, and dedication to God. Pharaoh’s act of placing his ring on Joseph’s hand (Genesis 41:42) and King Ahasuerus giving his ring to Haman and later Mordecai (Esther 3:10; 8:2) illustrate rings worn as badges of office and instruments of royal authority. Additionally, rings made of gold were offered as precious gifts to the Lord, demonstrating devotion and atonement (Exodus 35:22; Numbers 31:50). Rings also served as tokens of official approval, as seen in the sealing of royal decrees (Esther 3:12), highlighting their role in confirming and authenticating important communications.
